verdict.rationale: vLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support, letting AI-native users build against those standard SDKs rather than the raw HTTP API, and community comments confirm this OpenAI-compatible surface is used in practice (vllm-comm-2). However there is no evidence of a first-party vLLM-branded SDK/client library with its own docs. Missing for 10: dedicated vLLM SDK/client library documentation, language coverage beyond Python/OpenAI clients, independent hands-on SDK usage reports beyond the API-compatibility comment.
